bias.en: Rebound · cleared the 200-day and $388, under the SAR
bias.zh: 反弹 · 突破 200 日均线和 $388，仍低于抛物线 SAR

read.en: Tesla rose 2.9% on Nov 11 to $390.84, trading $386.35–395.43 on light volume (0.67x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($370.1), 10-day ($384.1), 30-day ($379.2), 100-day ($366.3) and 200-day ($383.0); only the 30-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($402.11), and RSI is 54.4.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月11日上涨 2.9%，收于 $390.84，盘中区间 $386.35–395.43，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.67 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$370.1）、10 日（$384.1）、30 日（$379.2）、100 日（$366.3）和 200 日均线（$383.0）上方；仅 30 日均线在上行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$402.11），RSI 为 54.4。

read.en: The gap higher cleared the 200-day, the 10-day and the $388 cap (Oct 9 high $388.56), now support; the $395.43 high stopped under the $396.5–398.5 Nov 3 low and close. Resistance is $395.4–398.5, then $402.1–406.5 (SAR, Nov 3 high) and $414.2 (Nov 2 high). Support is $386.4–388.6, then $383–384 (200 and 10-day) and $379.2–379.8 (30-day, Nov 10 close). A close above $398.5 would target $402–406.5; below $386.4, $383–384.

r.en: Nov 11 high $395.43; Nov 3 low $396.53; Nov 3 close $398.50

s.en: $388 cap since March, cleared; Oct 9 high $388.56; Nov 11 low $386.35
